newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange volume eases, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange volume eases, prices mixed.

text.p: Volume eased on the Istanbul gold exchange on Monday, but dealers said free market demand was expected to be firm ahead of the new year as banks and traders closed positions and jewellers bought for expected sales.
Volume dropped to 785 kilos from 830 kilos on Friday.

Prices were mixed, easing in dollar terms to $369.40 an ounce from Friday's $369.70, but rising in lira terms to 1,267,500 lira per gram from the previous 1,266,800 due to the lira's fall against the dollar.
"The approach of the new year had a large influence on the market, in the form of physical demand both from jewellers and from traders wishing to close positions before then," one dealer said.
There were 555 kilos traded in the morning session and 230 in the afternoon with 64.3 percent of the total in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-275 08 75
